story: In 580 the young Northern Zhou emperor was a child, and real power lay with his grandfather by marriage, Yang Jian, Duke of Sui. Yang crushed a rising by loyal generals and then, early in 581, had the boy hand over the throne. He named his dynasty after his title and took the reign name Kaihuang. Soon afterwards the princes of the old ruling house were killed.

As Emperor Wen, Yang Jian worked hard and lived frugally. With his chancellor Gao Jiong he rebuilt the government in Chang'an around three departments and six ministries, counted households, and granted land to farmers. In 582 he ordered a brand-new capital, Daxing, beside the ruined Han city. By the end of the decade he was ready to turn south.
story_zh: 580年，北周皇帝还是个孩子，朝政大权落在外戚、隋国公杨坚手里。杨坚先镇压了忠于北周的将领起兵，581年初便让小皇帝把皇位“禅让”给自己。他以封号“隋”为国号，改元开皇，不久又诛杀了北周宗室。
杨坚就是隋文帝。他勤于政务、生活节俭，与宰相高颎一起重建了以三省六部为核心的中央制度，清查户口，推行均田。582年，他下令在汉代长安旧城旁另建新都大兴城。到了这个十年的末尾，他已经准备好挥师南下。
sui-founded.why: The Sui set up the institutions that the Tang inherited almost unchanged.
sui-founded.why_zh: 隋朝建立的各项制度，几乎原封不动地被唐朝继承下来。

story: After years of preparation, including building warships on the upper Yangtze, Emperor Wen launched his attack on the southern Chen dynasty at the end of 588. About half a million men advanced on a wide front under the nominal command of his son Yang Guang, Prince of Jin.

Early in 589 the generals Heruo Bi and Han Qinhu crossed the Yangtze near Jiankang while the Chen court was celebrating the new year. Resistance collapsed. Han Qinhu's troops entered the city, and the last Chen ruler, Chen Shubao, was found hiding in a well with two of his consorts. The rest of the south submitted within weeks.
Chen Shubao was taken to the north and lived out his life as a well-treated captive.
story_zh: 隋文帝为灭陈准备多年，还在长江上游打造了大批战船。588年底，隋军五十余万人分路南下，名义上由他的儿子晋王杨广统率。
589年初，陈朝君臣还在欢度新年，贺若弼、韩擒虎两员大将已在建康附近渡过长江。陈军一触即溃。韩擒虎率军入城，陈后主陈叔宝带着两名妃子躲进一口井里，被隋军搜出。几周之内，南方各地纷纷归降。
陈叔宝被押往北方，此后一直作为俘虏受到优待，安度余生。
sui-conquers-chen.why: It ended the long split between north and south that began after the fall of Western Jin, and China stayed united for most of the next three centuries.
sui-conquers-chen.why_zh: 这场战争结束了西晋灭亡以来南北长期分裂的局面，此后近三百年中国大体保持统一。

story: In 605, his first full year on the throne, Emperor Yang ordered the Tongji Canal, which ran from Luoyang to the Yellow River and then southeast to the Huai. More than a million men and women were called up for the work. An older channel from the Huai to the Yangtze was rebuilt at the same time, and the emperor sailed to Jiangdu (Yangzhou) in a fleet of dragon boats.

In 608 the Yongji Canal was cut north toward the region of modern Beijing, the base for his wars in Korea, and in 610 the Jiangnan Canal reached Hangzhou. Together they formed a network of more than 2,000 kilometres centred on Luoyang. The forced labour cost many lives and helped turn the people against the Sui.
story_zh: 605年，隋炀帝即位后的第一个整年，就下令开凿通济渠：从洛阳引水入黄河，再向东南通到淮河。为此征发的男女民工超过百万。与此同时，从淮河到长江的旧水道也重新疏浚，炀帝乘着龙舟船队南下江都（今扬州）。
608年，永济渠向北开到今北京一带，那里是他征讨高句丽的基地；610年，江南河又通到杭州。几段运河连成一个以洛阳为中心、全长两千多公里的水运网。繁重的徭役夺走了无数性命，也让民心渐渐背离隋朝。
grand-canal.why: The canal tied the rich rice lands of the south to the political north and remained a main artery of the empire until the railway age.
grand-canal.why_zh: 运河把富庶的南方稻米产区和北方政治中心连在一起，直到铁路时代，一直是帝国的交通命脉。

quote.zh: 尽道隋亡为此河，至今千里赖通波。
quote.en: Everyone says this river ruined the Sui, yet to this day a thousand li depend on its flowing waves.
quote.from: Pi Rixiu, Thoughts on the Bian River 皮日休《汴河怀古》

story: For centuries officials had been chosen through the nine-rank system, which in practice favoured great families. Emperor Wen abolished it and from 587 asked each prefecture to send a set number of candidates to the capital to be tested. Under Emperor Yang a new degree, the jinshi or 'presented scholar', appears, testing candidates on writing and policy. The exact founding year is not recorded, so 605 is a traditional date.

The Tang widened the system, and under the Song it became the main road to office, with tens of thousands sitting the exams. Success depended on long study of the Confucian classics. The exams were finally abolished in 1905, after about 1,300 years.
story_zh: 几百年来，官员一直通过九品中正制选拔，实际上偏向世家大族。隋文帝废除了这一制度，从587年起要求各州每年按名额向京城举荐人才，参加考试。到隋炀帝时出现了“进士科”，考的是文章和对时政的见解。科举到底始于哪一年，史书没有明确记载，605年只是传统说法。
唐朝扩大了科举的规模，到了宋朝，它成为做官的主要途径，每次应考的人数以万计。想要考中，就得多年苦读儒家经典。科举直到1905年才被废除，前后延续了约一千三百年。
keju.why: Exams opened office to talent rather than birth alone and shaped Chinese education, society and values for over a thousand years.
keju.why_zh: 科举让出身之外的才学也能通往仕途，在一千多年里深刻影响了中国的教育、社会和价值观。

story: In 612 Emperor Yang gathered a vast army at Zhuojun, near modern Beijing; the histories give more than a million soldiers. The main force stalled for months before the walled city of Liaodong. To break the deadlock, about 300,000 men under Yuwen Shu and Yu Zhongwen were sent straight for the Goguryeo capital at Pyongyang.

The Goguryeo commander Eulji Mundeok fought and retreated again and again, drawing the hungry Sui troops deep into his country. He then sent Yu Zhongwen a mocking poem and offered a false surrender. As the exhausted Sui army fell back across the Salsu River, Goguryeo forces attacked in mid-crossing. According to the histories only 2,700 men made it home.
Emperor Yang tried again in 613 and 614, with no lasting result.
story_zh: 612年，隋炀帝在涿郡（今北京附近）集结大军，史书说兵力超过一百万。主力在辽东城下僵持了好几个月。为打破僵局，宇文述、于仲文率领约三十万人直扑高句丽都城平壤。
高句丽统帅乙支文德边打边退，把饥饿的隋军引向纵深。他还给于仲文写了一首嘲讽的诗，又假装投降。疲惫的隋军撤退渡过萨水时，高句丽军趁其半渡发起攻击。据史书记载，最后只有两千七百人生还。
隋炀帝在613年和614年又两次出兵，都没能取得实质成果。
goguryeo-campaign.why: The disaster cost the Sui its army and its credibility, and the uprisings it set off brought the dynasty down within six years.
goguryeo-campaign.why_zh: 这场惨败让隋朝赔上了军队和威信，由此引发的民变在六年内就葬送了隋朝。

quote.zh: 神策究天文，妙算穷地理。战胜功既高，知足愿云止。
quote.en: Your divine plans have plumbed the heavens; your clever schemes have mastered the earth. Your victories are many and your merit high; be content, and stop here.
quote.from: Eulji Mundeok, poem to Yu Zhongwen 乙支文德《遗于仲文诗》

story: Soon after taking the throne in 581, Emperor Wen ordered Gao Jiong and other ministers to draw up a new code of law. It was issued that year and revised in 583, when the emperor complained that it still had too many articles. The final version had 500 articles in twelve sections.

The code cut the number of crimes punished by death and abolished cruel penalties such as dismemberment and the killing of a criminal's relatives in many cases. It fixed a ladder of five punishments, from beating with a light stick to death, and listed the 'Ten Abominations', the gravest crimes such as treason and unfilial conduct, which could never be pardoned.
story_zh: 581年即位后不久，隋文帝就命高颎等大臣修订新法典，当年颁行。583年，文帝嫌条文仍然太繁，又下令删改，最后定为十二篇、五百条。
新律大幅减少了死罪，废除了车裂、枭首等酷刑，并在很多情况下取消了株连亲族的做法。它确立了笞、杖、徒、流、死五等刑罚，还列出“十恶”，即谋反、不孝等最严重的罪行，犯者不在赦免之列。
kaihuang-code.why: The Kaihuang Code was the direct model for the Tang Code, and through it shaped law in China, Japan, Korea and Vietnam for centuries.
kaihuang-code.why_zh: 《开皇律》是《唐律》的直接蓝本，并通过《唐律》影响了此后数百年中国、日本、朝鲜和越南的法律。

story: Han dynasty Chang'an had been in use for nearly eight hundred years and was cramped, with salty, polluted water. In 582 Emperor Wen decided to build a new capital a little to the southeast and put the young architect Yuwen Kai in charge. The court moved in the following spring, after less than a year of building.

Daxing was laid out on a strict grid. The palace and the government offices stood in the north, and the rest of the city was divided by straight avenues into more than a hundred walled wards, with an eastern and a western market. The walls enclosed over 80 square kilometres.
The Tang kept the city and called it Chang'an again. At its height about a million people lived there.
story_zh: 汉长安城已经使用了近八百年，城区狭小，地下水又咸又脏。582年，隋文帝决定在旧城东南另建新都，任命年轻的建筑家宇文恺负责规划。不到一年，新城就初具规模，朝廷第二年春天便迁了进去。
大兴城布局方正严整：宫城和皇城位于北部，其余城区被笔直的大街划分成一百多个四周有墙的里坊，另设东、西两市。城墙圈起的面积超过八十平方公里。
唐朝沿用这座城市，恢复了长安的名字。鼎盛时期，城中人口约有一百万。
daxing-city.why: Its grid plan was copied by later Chinese capitals and by the Japanese capitals at Nara and Heian (Kyoto).
daxing-city.why_zh: 大兴城的棋盘式布局为后世中国都城所仿效，日本的平城京（奈良）和平安京（京都）也照此建造。

story: In 582 the Turkic khan Ishbara led a huge army over the northern frontier to raid Sui lands. The new dynasty was still fragile, but its generals struck back the following year and won a series of battles in the north, including one at Baidao near modern Hohhot.

Sui diplomacy did as much as its armies. The officer Zhangsun Sheng, who knew the steppe well, advised the court to befriend distant khans and attack nearer ones, and to set the weaker chiefs against the stronger. The Turkic leaders were already quarrelling over the succession, and from 583 the khaganate split into an eastern half on the Mongolian steppe and a western half stretching into Central Asia.
Ishbara soon accepted Sui overlordship.
story_zh: 582年，突厥沙钵略可汗率大军越过北方边境，大肆劫掠。隋朝建立不久，根基未稳，但第二年隋军发起反击，在北方连战连捷，其中一仗就打在今呼和浩特附近的白道。
隋朝的外交手段和军事同样奏效。熟悉草原情况的将领长孙晟建议朝廷“远交而近攻，离强而合弱”。突厥各位首领本来就在为汗位明争暗斗，从583年起，汗国分裂成两半：东突厥占据蒙古草原，西突厥一直延伸到中亚。
不久，沙钵略可汗向隋朝称臣。
gokturk-split.why: The split shaped steppe politics for decades and let the Sui and early Tang deal with the Turks one half at a time.
gokturk-split.why_zh: 突厥的分裂影响了此后几十年的草原局势，使隋和唐初可以对东西突厥各个击破。

story: The Anji Bridge, better known as the Zhaozhou Bridge, crosses the Xiao River in what is now Zhao County, Hebei. A Tang inscription names its builder as Li Chun, a craftsman of the Sui. It was built roughly between 595 and 605; the exact years are not certain.

Its single stone arch spans about 37 metres but rises only about 7 metres, so carts could cross easily. Instead of filling the shoulders of the arch with solid stone, Li Chun opened two small arches on each side. This made the bridge lighter, saved stone and let floodwater pass through.
The bridge has survived floods, wars and earthquakes, and it is still standing after more than 1,400 years.
story_zh: 安济桥更为人熟知的名字是赵州桥，横跨在今河北赵县的洨河上。据唐代碑文记载，它的建造者是隋朝工匠李春，大约修建于595年至605年之间，确切年份已难以考证。
这座单孔石拱桥跨度约37米，拱高却只有约7米，车马往来十分方便。李春没有用实心石料填满拱肩，而是在两侧各开了两个小拱。这样既减轻了桥身重量、节省了石料，洪水来时还能从小拱中泄流。
一千四百多年来，赵州桥经受住了洪水、战乱和地震，至今依然屹立。
anji-bridge.why: It is the world's oldest surviving open-spandrel stone arch bridge, a design Europe did not use until many centuries later.
anji-bridge.why_zh: 它是世界上现存最古老的敞肩石拱桥，欧洲要到许多世纪后才出现类似设计。

story: Yang Guang was Emperor Wen's second son. He won over his parents with a show of frugality and in 600 replaced his elder brother Yang Yong as crown prince. In 604 Emperor Wen died at the Renshou Palace while Yang Guang was at his side; later historians suspected murder, but this cannot be proved. Yang Yong was forced to kill himself, and a revolt by another brother, Yang Liang, was put down within months.

The new ruler, known to history as Emperor Yang, started work at once. In 605 he ordered a new eastern capital at Luoyang and the first great canal, and he went on to build palaces, roads and a long wall in the north. Each project called up hundreds of thousands of labourers.
story_zh: 杨广是隋文帝的次子。他在父母面前装出节俭的样子，600年取代兄长杨勇成为太子。604年，文帝在仁寿宫去世，当时杨广就在身边。后世史家怀疑他弑父，但此事无法证实。杨勇被逼自尽，另一个弟弟杨谅起兵反抗，几个月内就被平定。
新皇帝就是历史上的隋炀帝。他一即位就大举动工：605年下令营建东都洛阳、开凿第一段大运河，之后又修宫殿、筑驰道、在北方修长城。每项工程都要征发几十万民工。
yang-accession.why: His ambitions gave China the Grand Canal and a rebuilt Luoyang, but the burden on ordinary people helped destroy his dynasty.
yang-accession.why_zh: 他的雄心给中国留下了大运河和重建的洛阳城，但压在百姓身上的重负也加速了隋朝的灭亡。

story: In 611 Emperor Yang ordered men and supplies from all over the north to gather for war against Goguryeo. That same year the Yellow River flooded large parts of Shandong and Hebei. In Zouping, Wang Bo gathered farmers on Changbai Mountain and spread a song telling people not to go and die in Liaodong.

As the Korean wars dragged on, revolts multiplied. Dou Jiande rose in Hebei, Du Fuwei in the Huai region, and the Wagang army in Henan, later led by Li Mi, seized the great state granaries near Luoyang. By 616 the emperor had left the north for Jiangdu, and local strongmen and Sui officials alike were building their own armies.
story_zh: 611年，隋炀帝下令从北方各地征调兵员和物资，准备讨伐高句丽。同一年，黄河泛滥，淹没了山东、河北大片地区。在邹平，王薄聚集农民据守长白山，编了一首《无向辽东浪死歌》，劝人们不要去辽东白白送死。
高句丽战事旷日持久，起义也越来越多：窦建德起于河北，杜伏威起于江淮，河南的瓦岗军后来由李密率领，夺取了洛阳附近的国家大粮仓。到616年，炀帝已经离开北方去了江都，各地豪强和隋朝官员纷纷拉起自己的队伍。
sui-uprisings.why: The rebellions destroyed Sui authority and opened the way for Li Yuan and his sons to found the Tang.
sui-uprisings.why_zh: 这些起义瓦解了隋朝的统治，为李渊父子建立唐朝铺平了道路。

story: The Wei River linked the capital with the Yellow River, but it was shallow, full of sandbars and wandered across its valley, so grain boats from the east moved slowly and often ran aground. As Daxing grew, it needed far more food than the surrounding land could grow.

In 584 Emperor Wen ordered Yuwen Kai, the planner of the new capital, to cut a straight canal beside the river. Running about 300 li from the capital to Tong Pass, it was finished within months. The emperor named it Guangtong, meaning 'broad passage'. Grain from the Yellow River plain could now reach the capital much more easily, and the canal was later rebuilt and used by the Tang.
story_zh: 渭河连接都城与黄河，但河道浅、沙洲多、曲折摆动，东来的运粮船行驶缓慢，还常常搁浅。大兴城日益繁荣，所需粮食远远超出关中本地的产量。
584年，隋文帝命新都的规划者宇文恺沿渭河另开一条笔直的运河，从都城一直通到潼关，长约三百里，几个月便告完工。文帝将它命名为“广通渠”。从此，黄河下游平原的粮食运进京城方便多了。唐朝后来又重新疏浚使用这条渠道。
guangtong-canal.why: It was the first of the Sui canal works that grew into the Grand Canal system.
guangtong-canal.why_zh: 它是隋朝一系列运河工程的开端，这些工程最终连成了大运河体系。

story: The Tuyuhun, a kingdom around Qinghai Lake, controlled part of the routes to the west. In 609 Emperor Yang led an army that drove them out and set up new commanderies in their land. He then crossed the Qilian Mountains to the Hexi Corridor; snowstorms in the passes killed many soldiers and animals.

At Zhangye the emperor held a grand reception. The official Pei Ju, who had gathered information about Central Asia from merchants and written an illustrated record of the Western Regions, had invited rulers and envoys from many states. The king of Gaochang and envoys from more than twenty states came to pay their respects, and trade fairs were held for foreign merchants.
story_zh: 吐谷浑是青海湖一带的一个政权，控制着通往西方的部分道路。609年，隋炀帝亲率大军将其击败，在其故地设置郡县。随后他翻越祁连山进入河西走廊，途中山口遭遇暴风雪，冻死了大量士兵和牲畜。
炀帝在张掖举行了盛大的接见仪式。官员裴矩曾向往来商人打听中亚各国的情况，编成图文并茂的《西域图记》，这次也是他出面邀请了各国君主和使者。高昌王和二十多个国家的使者前来朝见，炀帝还为外国商人举办了交易盛会。
yang-zhangye.why: It marked the height of Sui prestige in the west and foreshadowed Tang expansion along the Silk Road.
yang-zhangye.why_zh: 这是隋朝在西方声望的顶点，也预示了唐朝沿丝绸之路的扩张。

people.name: Pei Ju
people.role: Official in charge of western affairs

story: Yang Xuangan was the son of Yang Su, one of the founders of the Sui. In 613, while Emperor Yang was fighting his second campaign in Goguryeo, Yang Xuangan was in charge of shipping grain to the army from Liyang on the Yellow River. Seeing how unpopular the wars had become, he held back the supplies and rose in revolt.

Thousands joined him, and he besieged the eastern capital Luoyang. His adviser Li Mi urged him to cut off the emperor's road home or seize Chang'an, but he chose to attack Luoyang, which held out. The emperor hurried back from Korea, and government armies caught Yang Xuangan as he tried to march west. Within about two months he was dead and his followers were punished harshly.
story_zh: 杨玄感是隋朝开国功臣杨素之子。613年，隋炀帝第二次亲征高句丽，杨玄感奉命在黄河边的黎阳督运军粮。他看出百姓早已厌倦战争，便扣下粮草，起兵反隋。
数以万计的人前来投奔，他随即围攻东都洛阳。谋士李密劝他截断炀帝的归路，或者西取长安，他却执意强攻洛阳，久攻不下。炀帝急忙从辽东撤军，官军在杨玄感西进途中将他追上。前后约两个月，杨玄感兵败身死，追随者遭到严厉镇压。
yang-xuangan.why: It was the first revolt by a member of the Sui elite, a sign that even the ruling class was turning against Emperor Yang.
yang-xuangan.why_zh: 这是隋朝统治集团内部第一次公开反叛，说明连权贵阶层也开始背弃隋炀帝。

people.name: Yang Xuangan
people.role: Rebel leader, son of Yang Su

story: In the summer of 615 Emperor Yang toured the northern frontier. The Eastern Turkic khan Shibi, angry at Sui attempts to divide his people, led a large cavalry army south. Warned at the last moment, the emperor took refuge in the commandery seat of Yanmen. The Turks took most of the other towns in the region and surrounded him.

For about a month the court was trapped, and arrows fell near the emperor himself. Officials urged him to promise that there would be no more Korean wars and to reward the defenders. Messages were sent to Shibi's Chinese wife, Princess Yicheng, who warned him of trouble in the north, while relief armies gathered; one of the young officers among them was Li Shimin. The khan withdrew.
story_zh: 615年夏，隋炀帝巡视北部边境。东突厥始毕可汗不满隋朝分化其部众，率大批骑兵南下。炀帝在最后时刻得到警报，躲进了雁门郡城。突厥军攻下了郡内大部分城池，把他团团围住。
朝廷被困了约一个月，箭矢甚至落到炀帝跟前。大臣们劝他宣布停止征讨高句丽，并重赏守城将士。朝廷又派人联络嫁给始毕可汗的隋朝义成公主，她向可汗谎报北方告急；与此同时各路援军陆续赶到，年轻的李世民也在其中。始毕可汗最终撤兵。
siege-yanmen.why: Emperor Yang broke his promises after the siege, and soon afterwards he abandoned the north for Jiangdu, leaving it to rebels.
siege-yanmen.why_zh: 解围后，隋炀帝没有兑现承诺，不久便离开北方前往江都，把北方留给了各路起义军。

people.name: Princess Yicheng
people.role: Sui princess married to the khan
people.role_zh: 嫁给突厥可汗的隋朝公主

people.name: Li Shimin
people.role: Young officer in the relief army

story: Li Yuan, Duke of Tang, was a cousin of Emperor Yang and in 617 commanded the garrison at Taiyuan. With rebellions everywhere and the emperor far away in Jiangdu, his son Li Shimin and his adviser Pei Ji urged him to act. In the summer he raised an army, made peace with the Eastern Turks, who sent horses, and marched south down the Fen River valley.

After crossing the Yellow River, his forces grew quickly as local leaders joined him. Late in 617 he took Chang'an. Rather than claim the throne at once, he put Emperor Yang's young grandson Yang You on it and declared Emperor Yang retired. Real power was already his.
story_zh: 唐国公李渊是隋炀帝的表兄，617年任太原留守。当时天下大乱，皇帝又远在江都，他的儿子李世民和谋士裴寂都劝他起兵。这年夏天，李渊在晋阳起兵，先与东突厥讲和，换来对方送的马匹，然后沿汾河谷地南下。
渡过黄河后，各地豪强纷纷归附，队伍迅速壮大。617年底，李渊攻下长安。他没有马上称帝，而是拥立隋炀帝年幼的孙子杨侑为皇帝，尊炀帝为太上皇，实权早已握在自己手中。
li-yuan-taiyuan.why: Holding Chang'an and the Guanzhong region gave the Li family the base from which they founded the Tang the next year.
li-yuan-taiyuan.why_zh: 占据长安和关中，为李氏家族次年建立唐朝打下了根基。

people.name: Li Yuan
people.role: Sui commander at Taiyuan, later Emperor Gaozu of Tang
people.role_zh: 隋太原留守，后来的唐高祖
